timeout_semantics: a timeout is UNKNOWN: not a pass, not a failure, and never grounds for a rollback until the host is reconciled

host_adapter.site_id_source: the NETLIFY_SITE_ID environment variable at deploy time; never a committed .netlify/state.json
host_adapter.no_build_required: without --no-build the CLI runs a git build and uploads nothing from --dir, so the deployed bytes would not be the tested bytes
host_adapter.upload_and_publish: ONE operation for --prod: the host offers no separate activate step to hold, so the coordinator's parent guard runs immediately before the call
host_adapter.rollback: publish an earlier deploy (restore); the host does not undo, which is why the previous release lives in durable release storage
host_adapter.scaffolding_side_effect: the CLI writes a gitignored .netlify/ that fails the assembler gate; remove it after every deploy

run_against: a local or staged origin; production only under a separately authorised pilot
